blocker.detail: The Python google-cloud-bigquery client is available in the project environment, but Application Default Credentials and an explicit billing/quota project are not configured. Authenticated dry-runs and bounded extraction are refused until both are present.
human_bootstrap_actions: Install Google Cloud SDK once (provides gcloud for ADC login): brew install --cask google-cloud-sdk
Create or select a billed GCP project with the BigQuery API enabled (Console → project create / billing linked; enable BigQuery API). Do not invent a project ID.
Authenticate Application Default Credentials: gcloud auth application-default login
Bind the ADC quota/billing project (replace YOUR_BILLING_PROJECT): gcloud auth application-default set-quota-project YOUR_BILLING_PROJECT
Export the billing/quota project for this shell: export GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=YOUR_BILLING_PROJECT
Ensure the Python client is installed in the project venv: .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-google2019.txt
If 01–03 fit the guard, execute only the frozen bounded extract: .venv/bin/python -m dynapm.scripts.task28_google2019_acquisition --execute-bounded --billing-project YOUR_BILLING_PROJECT
blocker.resolution: Authenticate ADC, set an explicit billed GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT / --billing-project, then run guarded dry-runs before any extraction.

budget_guard.bounded_time_filter_not_a_cost_guarantee: instance_usage/instance_events are not documented as partitioned on start_time. A [7d,15d) predicate may still scan a full cell table; dry-run bytes, not the SQL filter, determine cost.
budget_guard.first_tib_month_note: Official pricing lists first 1 TiB/month/account free; do not assume remaining allowance.

cadence_and_missingness.ambiguous_same_time_requests: exclude event timestamp unless request pair is unique
cadence_and_missingness.duplicate_rule: within entity+bucket choose greatest end_time, then smallest source-row SHA-256
cadence_and_missingness.missing_slots: leave absent; never interpolate, forward-fill, or upsample
cadence_and_missingness.short_lifetime_edge_windows: retain if duration is positive and <=300s

canonical_output.timestamp_semantics: trace-relative microseconds at nominal bucket start

normalization.request_alignment: latest unambiguous positive request event with event.time <= usage.start_time
normalization.zero_missing_request: row invalid; never divide or carry backward from future

population.bounded_selection: up to two FARM_FINGERPRINT-ranked entities per (cell, has_request_change, has_missing_slot) metadata stratum
